title: Fynkel asset sidecar
description: `<file>.meta.json` next to a source asset (ADR-0006, blueprint §6 Asset identity and import): the asset's stable id, the importer that reads it, that importer's settings, and the stable ids of the sub-assets the importer produces. Moving an asset means moving the file and its sidecar together; the id never changes. Documents (`.scene.json`, `.prefab.json`, `.material.json`, `.shader.json`) carry their own id and have no sidecar.

importer.description: Namespaced importer id, chosen from the file extension by `fynkel asset init`: fynkel.gltf, fynkel.image, fynkel.audio, fynkel.file.

importerVersion.description: The importer version that last wrote `settings`; a newer importer migrates them.

settings.description: Importer-defined; validated by the importer (M2-10 onwards).

subAssets.description: Sub-asset id (as used in an assetRef's `sub`) → the sub-asset's own stable uuid. Written by the importer on first import; kept across re-imports so references survive.

subId.description: Importer-defined path-like id of a sub-asset, such as mesh/Body or anim/walk: the part's kind and its name in the source file (docs/design/stable-sub-asset-ids.md). `#3` stands for an unnamed part at position 3, `~2` for the second part with the same name.
